about: RBL Bank Limited operates as a scheduled commercial bank in India. It operates through Corporate/Wholesale Banking, Retail Banking, Treasury, and Other Banking Operations segments. The company offers savings, salary, current, special institutions, and seafarer accounts; safe deposit lockers; fixed, recurring, and smart deposits; and portfolio investment schemes.
